comment: What can I say - the man is great. On day one he promised us that contracts would be more interesting than what we might expect it to be. Not only did he live up to that promise, he surpassed it. I was always excited to come to class and literally shed a tear on the last day. Genuinely cares about his students and UR LAW is so lucky to have him.

This man is hands down the best professor you will ever have. He makes his class so easy and understandable, and I have never had a professor that cares about his students more than Spalding. He also wrote his own textbook and makes it FREE for everyone - and the textbook reads like a buzzfeed article. Seriously, this man is the GOAT
